meta.title: XSGD ecosystem research
meta.scope: Public primary sources only. Initial dated baseline; no commissioned recurring collection.
meta.coverage: Announcements, official product pages and partner directories. No authenticated API calls, order-book snapshots, chain verification, private commercial terms or independently audited adoption data.

evidence.statement: Grab published a November 2025 MOU announcement with StraitsX to explore Web3 wallets and regional stablecoin settlement.
evidence.scope: Existence and exploratory scope of the announcement; regional rollout unverified.
evidence.independentCheck: StraitsX publishes the same MOU; this corroborates announcement, not operating outcomes.

evidence.statement: StraitsX says the Alipay+ / GrabPay Singapore integration has been live since October 2024 with PBM and SGD settlement.
evidence.scope: Singapore merchant flow; not a claim that all proposed Asian markets are live.
evidence.independentCheck: No independent transaction or merchant sample checked.

evidence.statement: The case study reports 174% year-on-year transaction growth and 2.5× unique-user growth for Alipay+ payments at GrabPay merchants.
evidence.scope: Provider-reported figures; period, base counts, value and attribution to XSGD not supplied.
evidence.independentCheck: No independently audited adoption series; do not use as total XSGD payment adoption.

evidence.statement: StraitsX's cross-border directory lists KBank and Q Wallet with XSGD.
evidence.scope: Directory presence; live Thailand corridors and bilateral contract scope unverified.
evidence.independentCheck: KBank operating status not independently checked.

evidence.statement: StraitsX's card directory lists Visa and RedotPay under its ecosystem.
evidence.scope: Listing only; token labels are not proof of a given card's settlement currency.
evidence.independentCheck: Customer story adds program detail for RedotPay.

evidence.statement: The RedotPay customer story describes Visa BIN sponsorship, Apple Pay support, USD virtual-account funding and XUSD-backed settlement.
evidence.scope: Described program uses XUSD; an XSGD extension remains hypothetical.
evidence.independentCheck: Named customer perspective included; no scheme certification or transaction sample checked.

evidence.statement: Coinbase's official XSGD product page advertises the XSGD/USDC pair, SGD conversion and Base transfers; StraitsX announced the partnership in September 2025.
evidence.scope: Public product availability evidence; live account eligibility and execution untested.
evidence.independentCheck: Product page corroborates issuer announcement.

evidence.statement: StraitsX announced a Solana Foundation collaboration in December 2025, including plans to develop liquidity.
evidence.scope: Announcement and plan, not depth measurement.
evidence.independentCheck: Later issuer launch post reviewed.

evidence.statement: StraitsX announced XSGD and XUSD live on Solana and supported on its platform on March 31, 2026.
evidence.scope: Issuer launch claim; current mint state, supported account flows and depth unverified.
evidence.independentCheck: No RPC or explorer-state check; older guide conflicts on supported flows.

evidence.statement: The StraitsX DeFi directory lists the Uniswap protocol with XSGD and XUSD.
evidence.scope: Permissionless protocol ecosystem listing; no bilateral Uniswap Labs deal inferred.
evidence.independentCheck: Pools, contracts and quotes not sampled.

evidence.statement: Public Swap API docs list XSGD/USDC and XSGD/XUSD pairs and expiring quotes.
evidence.scope: Documentation only; not exchange depth, API access or commercial commitment.
evidence.independentCheck: No authenticated quote or order submitted.

evidence.statement: The March Solana launch post and the January transfer guide's 'coming soon' label disagree on Solana support.
evidence.scope: Documentation discrepancy. Later announcement supports launch, but guide may describe different account flows.
evidence.independentCheck: Both pages opened on the baseline date; product flow still needs confirmation.

evidence.statement: Nium's August 2026 launch page says customers fund in USDC, Nium converts to USD, and payouts land in local currency.
evidence.scope: USD funding path; XSGD funding, SGD-specific economics and eligibility not established.
evidence.independentCheck: No funded payout, pricing or corridor test.

evidence.statement: Nium announced participation in Visa's stablecoin settlement pilot in November 2025, including USDC.
evidence.scope: Pilot announcement; does not establish XSGD scheme settlement.
evidence.independentCheck: Canonical dateline reviewed; live settlement not tested.

evidence.statement: Open Standard's June 2026 Open USD announcement lists StraitsX and Nium among participants.
evidence.scope: Shared announced ecosystem, not bilateral XSGD partnership or signed economics.
evidence.independentCheck: List read; no bilateral agreement or participant implementation verified.

evidence.statement: StraitsX's September newsletter says it released an autonomous-commerce whitepaper with Visa and the Singapore FinTech Association.
evidence.scope: Public research collaboration; prototypes and a paper do not establish production usage.
evidence.independentCheck: Full paper and production controls not evaluated.

evidence.statement: Existing Singapore acceptance makes corridor-level expansion worth investigating before treating these organizations as new leads.
evidence.scope: Research prioritization; no commitment to launch or contact.
evidence.independentCheck: Would fail if incremental merchant demand or compliant settlement economics are weak.

evidence.statement: Nium's USDC funding flow provides a concrete point to test SGD treasury demand; the reviewed sources do not establish a bilateral StraitsX relationship.
evidence.scope: Prospective XSGD hypothesis. Shared Open USD membership is not evidence of bilateral terms.
evidence.independentCheck: Disprove with no SGD treasury demand, a closed token policy or unfavorable conversion costs.

evidence.statement: Measure execution and redemption readiness before adding liquidity incentives or another distribution integration.
evidence.scope: Proposed research sequence; supply, volume and a listing cannot establish payment adoption.
evidence.independentCheck: Would lose priority if independent quotes show sufficient depth and no user conversion bottleneck.

evidence.statement: Alipay+ describes itself as a cross-border wallet gateway and a business pillar of Ant International.
evidence.scope: Product and organization identity; distinguish Alipay+ from the Alipay consumer wallet.
evidence.independentCheck: Official brand page read; no operating-volume claims adopted.

organizations.name: Grab
organizations.relationshipSummary: Existing Singapore payment integration described publicly; November 2025 regional Web3 MOU is exploratory.
organizations.relevance: Existing merchant access provides a distribution base for incremental XSGD settlement corridors.
organizations.uncertainty: Country rollout, incremental XSGD payment volumes, regulatory gating and commercial terms remain unknown.
nextQuestions: Which proposed markets have publicly confirmed launch dates?
What merchant and repeat-user payment metrics distinguish incremental use from existing rails?

organizations.name: Ant International
organizations.relationshipSummary: Alipay+ is the relevant Ant International product; StraitsX describes an existing GrabPay integration. Do not conflate Alipay+ with the Alipay consumer wallet.
organizations.relevance: Existing foreign-wallet acceptance can expand SGD merchant settlement use cases.
organizations.uncertainty: Wallet-by-wallet availability, transaction denominators, settlement economics and bilateral terms are unknown.
nextQuestions: Which wallet-origin corridors produce repeat Singapore merchant spend?
What is the precise role of XSGD versus PBM wrappers and final SGD payout?

organizations.name: KASIKORNBANK
organizations.relationshipSummary: KBank and Q Wallet already appear in StraitsX's XSGD cross-border ecosystem directory. Bilateral scope and live corridors are unverified.
organizations.relevance: Thai–Singapore merchant settlement is a specific extension to test within the existing ecosystem.
organizations.uncertainty: Directionality, launch stage, account eligibility and commercial terms unknown; directory listing alone is insufficient.
nextQuestions: Is there a public live SGD–THB acceptance and settlement flow?
Which entity provides FX, redemption and exception handling?

organizations.name: Nium
organizations.relationshipSummary: Bilateral StraitsX relationship unknown in this source set. Both are announced Open USD participants; that does not establish a bilateral partnership.
organizations.relevance: Test whether customers with SGD treasury could benefit from an XSGD conversion and payout connector.
organizations.uncertainty: XSGD policy, buyer demand, corridor economics, access and bilateral commercial terms all unknown.
nextQuestions: Is SGD-funded treasury demand material enough to justify a connector?
Can an external issuer token be accepted, or is USDC/Open USD the preferred policy?
How do all-in conversion costs compare with current SGD fiat funding?

organizations.name: Open Standard
organizations.relationshipSummary: Open USD's June announcement lists StraitsX as a participant. No XSGD distribution agreement is established by that announcement.
organizations.relevance: Shared ecosystem can be a research context for SGD/USD interoperability and competing issuer economics.
organizations.uncertainty: Signed terms, actual participant implementation, governance rights and XSGD conversion plans unknown.
nextQuestions: Are public implementation or token-policy documents available?
Does the model permit an SGD leg, and does that add value over existing conversion?

organizations.name: Coinbase
organizations.relationshipSummary: Existing announced StraitsX partnership and official XSGD product page; a new-listing pitch would duplicate known work.
organizations.relevance: An existing fiat and exchange route provides a benchmark for executable SGD liquidity.
organizations.uncertainty: Real spreads, executable size, geography/account limits and commercial terms not tested.
nextQuestions: What do timestamped quotes show at representative payment sizes?
Which transfer networks and redemption routes are available to the target user?

organizations.name: Solana Foundation
organizations.relationshipSummary: December 2025 collaboration precedes a March 2026 issuer launch announcement. This is an existing initiative.
organizations.relevance: Same-chain SGD and USD rails make execution and payment settlement readiness worth measuring.
organizations.uncertainty: Mint state, executable depth, market-maker commitments and supported account flows unverified; transfer guide conflicts.
nextQuestions: Are issuer mint addresses and redemption routes current and functional?
What is executable depth and slippage for XSGD/XUSD and XSGD/USDC?
Does the older 'coming soon' guidance describe a still-unsupported account flow?

organizations.name: Uniswap Labs
organizations.relationshipSummary: StraitsX lists the Uniswap protocol in its ecosystem. A bilateral relationship with Uniswap Labs is unknown; protocol pools are permissionless.
organizations.relevance: An existing protocol route is a comparison point for pool depth and total execution costs.
organizations.uncertainty: Exact pools, contracts, chains, LP concentration and Labs commercial relationship unknown.
nextQuestions: Which authentic-token pools offer executable liquidity at target sizes?
Are quoted improvements durable without subsidies and concentrated LP exposure?

organizations.name: Visa
organizations.relationshipSummary: Existing StraitsX card ecosystem listing and public research collaboration. Neither establishes scheme settlement in XSGD.
organizations.relevance: Card infrastructure is a possible distribution context; payment-card spend must be tied to its actual settlement token.
organizations.uncertainty: XSGD-specific card flows, scheme currency requirements, program economics and terms unknown.
nextQuestions: Which programs actually settle an SGD obligation using XSGD?
What controls and funding requirements apply before any agentic prototype becomes production?

organizations.name: RedotPay
organizations.relationshipSummary: Existing StraitsX customer story describes an XUSD-backed card program. XSGD use is unverified.
organizations.relevance: Observe the existing distribution model and test an SGD extension only if a real local-currency need exists.
organizations.uncertainty: SGD user demand, eligible markets, XSGD settlement and private commercial terms unknown.
nextQuestions: Do target users fund or spend enough SGD to need a distinct settlement leg?
Would XSGD improve treasury economics versus the established XUSD program?

priorities.title: Deepen the existing QR corridor
priorities.thesis: Start from existing Singapore merchant acceptance, then test one incremental wallet or market corridor with a clear SGD settlement need.
priorities.whyNow: Existing integration evidence and the regional MOU provide a concrete base, while live rollout and adoption attribution remain unresolved.
priorities.nextAction: Map one proposed corridor's public launch status, merchant demand and settlement route; define the incremental payment metric before assessing expansion.
assumptions: Incremental merchant or wallet demand exists beyond the current Singapore flow.
XSGD improves a compliant settlement path after FX, payout and exception costs.
disproves: The MOU has no reachable production corridor or regulatory route.
Repeat merchant demand is weak, or existing rails already deliver better all-in economics.
priorities.confidenceReason: Existing flow described, but adoption figures and new-market economics are not independently verified.

priorities.title: Test Nium's need for an SGD leg
priorities.thesis: Investigate whether an XSGD-to-USDC or USD connector solves a specific SGD treasury problem in Nium's existing funding and payout model.
priorities.whyNow: Nium announced USDC funding in August 2026; Open USD participation adds shared ecosystem context and a competing token policy to investigate.
priorities.nextAction: Build a public product-gap memo for SGD funding: buyer demand, accepted-token policy, eligible SGD payout route, and all-in cost versus fiat funding.
assumptions: A meaningful segment holds SGD treasury and wants stablecoin-funded payouts.
Nium can support an external-token conversion route at useful economics.
disproves: Demand is predominantly USD, or no SGD treasury problem is observable.
Token policy is closed, or conversion and compliance costs erase any advantage.
priorities.confidenceReason: Product adjacency is evidenced; bilateral status, XSGD acceptance and buyer demand remain unknown.

priorities.title: Measure liquidity before adding rails
priorities.thesis: Compare executable XSGD conversion and redemption through existing exchange and onchain routes before proposing another integration or liquidity incentive.
priorities.whyNow: Solana has an issuer launch announcement and Coinbase has an established product; operational documentation and execution capacity still need reconciliation.
priorities.nextAction: Collect read-only, timestamped bid/ask or swap quotes at S$1k, S$10k and S$100k equivalents, including fees, slippage, authentic-token verification and redemption constraints.
assumptions: Payment users face a real conversion or redemption bottleneck.
Depth can be improved sustainably and without unacceptable concentration or exit risk.
disproves: Existing routes already meet execution and redemption needs at target sizes.
There is no incremental payment demand, or improvements depend on uneconomic subsidies.
priorities.confidenceReason: Distribution and launch evidence exists; live depth and economic bottleneck are unmeasured.

decisions.proposal: Investigate one incremental QR corridor before recommending regional expansion.
decisions.rationale: A known integration is a starting point; incremental demand and XSGD contribution need evidence.

decisions.proposal: Prepare a public SGD product-gap memo for Nium; keep relationship and commercial terms unknown.
decisions.rationale: A recent USDC funding flow is specific enough to test an SGD connector hypothesis.

decisions.proposal: Benchmark existing liquidity and reconcile Solana account support before proposing incentives.
decisions.rationale: A listing, supply growth and chain launch do not establish usable payment liquidity.

changes.title: First public-evidence baseline
changes.summary: Ten organizations, three investigation proposals and a dated evidence ledger captured. No previous snapshot exists; no detected-change claim is made.
